verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS, which could plausibly ship a natural-language assistant or command interface, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such capability: it documents APIs, SDKs, webhooks, a Zapier no-code integration and a manual Customer Portal. The llms.txt file only exposes documentation to LLMs and is adjacent at best; it does not let users operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
